findings.title: Titled 'mutual' but only FinServe's information is protected and only AtliQ is bound
findings.quote: "Confidential Information" means all information, in any form, disclosed or made available by or on behalf of the Company to the Recipient or its Representatives, whether before or after the Effective Date,
findings.explanation: Recital B says the parties expect 'a mutual exchange of information', but the only definition of Confidential Information covers information coming from the Company (FinServe plus its Affiliates) to AtliQ. Every duty in clause 2 (use limits, secrecy, security, responsibility for Representatives) falls on 'the Recipient', which is defined as AtliQ. Nothing protects AtliQ's own architecture, methods or pricing if AtliQ shares them, and the arrangement the tracker note calls 'our standard mutual NDA' does not do what the title says. This fails the checklist line 'NDAs -> just sign if mutual'.

findings.title: 12-month non-compete on AtliQ across India financial services, starting on signature
findings.quote: In order to protect the Confidential Information, the Recipient shall not, during the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (12) months after its termination, provide services similar to those contemplated by the Proposed Transaction to any Competitor.
findings.explanation: The Proposed Transaction is data analytics and reporting solutions for FinServe's lending and wealth businesses (Recital A). 'Competitor' means any bank, NBFC, wealth manager, broker or fintech platform operating in India that offers products substantially similar to the Company's, and 'the Company' includes FinServe's Affiliates. The ban runs from the Effective Date for the whole term and 12 months after, even if no engagement follows, and binds AtliQ only. The checklist treats a non-compete in an NDA as a fail.

findings.title: 24-month no-hire on any employee or consultant of FinServe and its Affiliates
findings.quote: The Recipient shall not, during the term of this Agreement and for a period of twenty-four (24) months after its termination, directly or indirectly solicit, hire or engage any employee or consultant of the Company.
findings.explanation: This bars AtliQ from hiring or engaging (not just soliciting) any FinServe employee or consultant for the term plus 24 months, and 'the Company' includes FinServe's Affiliates. It is not limited to people AtliQ met, and nothing stops FinServe doing the same to AtliQ. A no-hire in an NDA is a fail under the checklist. The Meridian NDA signed in July is narrower (only people AtliQ had contact with) and the Al Noor, PayTrack, Acme and Sunrise contracts have mutual no-solicit clauses only.

findings.title: Residuals clause lets FinServe use what it remembers from AtliQ, with no matching protection for AtliQ
findings.quote: Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement, the Company shall be free to use Residuals for any purpose, including the development, marketing and procurement of products and services, provided that this Clause 4.1 does not grant any licence under any patent or copyright.
findings.explanation: 'Residuals' means information remembered by anyone who saw material exchanged in the discussions, including ideas, concepts, know-how and techniques (§1.4). Only the Company may use them, and because AtliQ's own information is not 'Confidential Information' under §1.2, AtliQ's methods and architecture shared at the walkthrough are neither protected nor excluded from this free use. A residuals clause in an NDA is a fail under the checklist; no signed AtliQ NDA on file contains one.
findings.seller_text: The draft lets one side reuse ideas and know-how it picks up in the meetings. Ask Karandeep.

findings.title: One-way, uncapped indemnity for any breach, including breaches by AtliQ's advisers and staff
findings.quote: The Recipient shall indemnify the Company for all losses, costs and expenses (including legal fees) arising from any breach of this Agreement by the Recipient or its Representatives.
findings.explanation: AtliQ would pay all losses and legal costs from any breach, with no cap (the draft has no liability limit at all), and 'Representatives' includes directors, officers, employees and professional advisers. FinServe gives no indemnity and has no limit on its own side. Clause 10.1 also gives only the Company injunctive relief and specific performance 'without proof of actual damage'. This fails the checklist lines 'indemnity -> mutual' and 'liability -> 1x fees. NOT unlimited'.

findings.title: Open-ended term and perpetual one-way secrecy
findings.quote: The obligations of the Recipient under this Agreement shall survive termination and shall continue in perpetuity.
findings.explanation: The agreement has no end date; it runs until someone gives 30 days' notice, and AtliQ's duties then continue forever. The signed NDAs on file all end: Meridian 3 years + 3, Harrington 2 years + 3, Al Noor 2 years + 5. Clause 2.2 also stops AtliQ saying that discussions are taking place without FinServe's consent, so AtliQ could not name FinServe as a prospect or reference. Exposure is bounded in the sense that AtliQ can end the term, but not the duties.
